messages:
customer_janet: Hey team :wave: — looks like the free trial credits we redeemed last week landed in my old personal workspace (ws_72) instead of our company org (org_acmeretail). I think there are two linked accounts somehow. Can those credits be moved to org_acmeretail?

maria_cs: Sorry about that, Janet. Can you DM me the org id for AcmeRetail and the email you used on the personal workspace? I can start the escalation.

customer_janet: DM sent — acme_org_id: org_9982, personal_ws_id: ws_72, email: janet@acmeretail.com. Also attaching a screenshot in the DM showing the credits balance on the personal workspace.

ryan_support: Looping in billing/ops. @alex_sre can you check if this is the duplicate-org flow we saw earlier with GitHub SSO creating a shadow workspace?

alex_sre: Will take a look. Quick question: was there any invite flow or org rename recently? Those can create a new workspace instead of migrating credits.

customer_janet: We accepted an invite last month, then created a new org for the product team and used the same email. No explicit rename that I recall.

maria_cs: Thanks. Repro steps so we have a record: 1) user redeems trial promo on account A (personal) 2) user signs up or accepts invite for org B using same email 3) platform creates separate workspace and credits stay on A.

ryan_support: For ops: can we verify credit allocation in the ledger and then run manual transfer? I have the IDs: from ws_72 (ledger id led_7002) to org_9982 (ledger id led_9982).

billing_bot: Ticket created: CS-6789 — Manual credit reallocation requested. Billing action required.

ops_bot: Running preflight check: `rbx-billing lookup --ledger led_7002 --summary`

ops_bot: Preflight output: total_credits: 800.00, used: 45.3, available: 754.7, owner: ws_72 (user janet@acmeretail.com)

alex_sre: Confirming: these look like trial promo credits (promo_code: TRIAL-2026-ACME). No conflicting subscription.

ryan_support: OK to proceed with transfer? We'll move 754.7 credits to org_9982 and leave zero on the old ws. @maria_cs please confirm we have user approval in DM.

maria_cs: Confirmed — customer approves transfer.

ops_bot: Executing transfer command: `rbx-billing transfer --from led_7002 --to led_9982 --amount 754.7 --note "manual transfer CS-6789"`

ops_bot: Command result: SUCCESS. new_balances: led_7002: 0.0, led_9982: 754.7

billing_bot: Billing ledger updated, promo tag retained on destination ledger.

alex_sre: Root cause note: signup/invite flow created a separate workspace when an already-redeemed account used same email with invite. Engineering ticket recommended to surface a merge/migrate prompt during invite flow. Filing ENG-1142.

maria_cs: Janet — we moved 754.7 trial credits into AcmeRetail (org_9982). Can you confirm you see the balance in the Console? :eyes:

customer_janet: I see it now, thanks so much! :white_check_mark: That fixed our immediate issue.

maria_cs: Great. I'll mark the support ticket CS-6789 as resolved after a quick follow-up in 24h to confirm no residual access issues. Closing notes: credit transfer executed by ops, promo retained, engineering ticket ENG-1142 created for UX fix.

customer_janet: Appreciated — please keep ENG-1142 on the priority list, this blocked our onboarding flow.

ryan_support: Noted. We'll ping product to prioritize the invite UX fix. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
